name: Anymail Finder
summary: Find and verify business emails by person, company, decision-maker role or LinkedIn URL, charged only for valid hits.

api_key.description: Anymail Finder API key (account API page; click Enable API if hidden). Sent raw, with no Bearer prefix.

notes: You are charged only when a valid email is returned; not found, blacklisted and (since 2026-10-05) risky results are free. Repeat searches within 30 days are free.
Searches wait for the answer unless the x-webhook-url header is set, in which case the result is POSTed there.
Bulk and GeoLead jobs are not included here beyond status; credits are charged on first download of results.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Remaining credit balance and account email.

endpoints.name: Find a person's email
endpoints.summary: Find one person's email from a company (domain or name) and their name, or from a LinkedIn URL alone.

company_name.description: Company name, used if no domain is given.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL; may be sent on its own.

webhook_url.description: If set, the result is POSTed to this URL instead of waiting for the response.

notes: A read over POST: searches for an email, changes nothing.
1 credit, charged only when a valid email is found; not found or blacklisted results are free, and repeats within 30 days are free.
Needs a domain or company_name plus a name, unless linkedin_url is sent alone.

endpoints.name: Find a decision maker's email
endpoints.summary: Find the email of a decision maker at a company by role category.

company_name.description: Company name, used if no domain is given.

webhook_url.description: If set, the result is POSTed to this URL instead of waiting for the response.

notes: 2 credits, charged only when a valid email is found; repeats within 30 days are free.
Categories: ceo, engineering, finance, hr, it, logistics, marketing, operations, buyer, sales.
